steps.content: In the aftermath of her narrow escape, the bandaged man makes quick work of the remaining assassins while Hypatia slumps against the stone statue, gasping for breath.
The man, however, seems utterly unruffled. After using a quick, efficient sorcery to "cleanse" the ground of traces, he turns back to Hypatia with a smile.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Thank you.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: First time I've been thanked by a Campbell with such sincerity. You're welcome, miss. I'm simply glad to settle our... disagreement. Clearing up this misunderstanding is a welcome bonus.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Well then, nothing more to dwell on this time, I hope? Do remember to head home early. I wish you the best of luck. Farewell.

His graceful exit is met with neither the reaction he expected nor an uncompromising demand to stay. Instead, Hypatia sinks into a painful crouch, curling around herself as she clutches her side. Blood is already seeping through her fingers.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Ngh... It hurts... so much...

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: ...You're injured? From those assassins?

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: That's not good... Let me see.
He moves forward to check on her, but after only a few steps, his hands are suddenly ensnared by ropes of transformed Aurum Secretum.
Hypatia looks up, her face still pale from blood loss, but her eyes are now clear of any pain, holding only cool, deliberate focus.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Got you.
For a few seconds, they simply stare. Then Rust's expression cracks, and he throws his head back with a laugh of pure admiration.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: I take back my earlier statement. Never releasing your prey once sighted, even leveraging your own wounds... You truly are a Campbell through and through.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: What is the charge, then? Do you still consider me guilty, even now?
His words give Hypatia pause. Her first instinct is to explain—to credit the method to a friend from DisCity, not the Campbell legacy. But what leaves her lips is something else altogether.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I'm sorry. I don't mean to accuse you of a crime, nor do I wish to repay kindness with betrayal. This is simply... to ensure you don't slip away again.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I regret the necessity, but you are far too adept at vanishing. If I let you go now, I may never catch up. Please, tell me the truth. The circumstances leave me no choice. I must have answers.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What is the nature of that sorcery? What is your connection to those assassins? They attacked my friend and me before. Are they hunting you as well? You said Fraser has grown unsettled. What do you know?
Her questions grow sharper, more urgent, edging into something like a plea.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Tell me everything, please! Do this, and I will release the restraints immediately. Otherwise, they will bind you no matter where you go.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Oh? Aurum Secretum shackles that pursue their target... Like this?
Hypatia glances down at her hands, only to discover that the bandaged man has somehow slipped the handcuffs. Now, her own wrists are locked together, immobilized.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mmph—you!
Whatever else she might try, her tools have already been confiscated.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: I'll be holding onto these as well. Your little gadgets are quite remarkable. I'll return them once I've made my safe departure.
As he speaks, he casts a series of swift, precise sorceries that lock Hypatia in place. Then, meeting her defiant glare, he sits down casually and reaches for her personal bag.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Please give that back to me!
He draws out a palm-sized photograph. In it, Hypatia stands shoulder-to-shoulder with a girl whose hair is the color of lilac, the blazing sunset of Furor painting the sky behind them.
He lifts the photo to the moonlight, studying it with quiet intensity.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: This is you and your friend, isn't it? Such a radiant bond... it inspires envy.
He stares at it a moment, an unreadable flicker in his eyes. Before Hypatia can parse his expression, he carefully tucks the photo away and returns the bag to her. Then...

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: But not every gift from a friend deserves your unwavering trust. For instance, this—
His hand darts behind her collar, and from the lining of her clothes, he extracts a small bird crafted from Aurum Secretum.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is...?
Recognition flashes through her: this is the communications network she built with Margaret!

They had used this very technology to beam Aurum Secretum data to DisCity in a split second. But... why would Margaret place it there, inside her collar? When did she have the chance? How could Hypatia have missed it completely...?

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: A listening device, it seems. Or a tracker. Quite fresh, placed very recently... Someone has been quietly monitoring your movements.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Do you know who is responsible, Miss Campbell?
She knows. The name sits on her tongue, but after a faltering breath, she swallows it and chooses silence.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: Unwilling to say? It must be another friend of yours. You refuse to betray a friend. How commendable. I imagine this is the same friend who sent you to find me.

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: You trust her so completely, risking your life on her behalf. But what has she truly offered you in return? For instance... even basic honesty?

steps.speaker: Bandaged Man
steps.content: When she placed this little tracker on you and sent you into danger, was she being honest with you then?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Please, don't speak of her that way. She—
Just then, the small bird begins to vibrate.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: That will be enough, sir. Please refrain from that divisive rhetoric. The girl before you has already endured harsh trials. What she needs now is assurance, not to be pushed into an abyss of doubt and fear. At the very least, I value her trust and am deeply concerned for her safety.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: I believe I still hold some credibility with you, do I not?

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: It has been some time, Agent Rust. And you have worked hard, Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: How courteous, DisCity's "Peace Dove." I must admit, I didn't expect our reunion to take place under these circumstances.
They trade barbed remarks like old sparring partners, their words sparking in the space between them. Hypatia watches from the sidelines, utterly bewildered.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...You two... know each other? But Ms. Margaret clearly stated he was from the Underground, that he was...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What is truly happening here?

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: I am sorry, Hypatia. Had I not said that, you would have insisted on remaining by my side to protect me. You have always been such a noble-hearted soul.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: But I wanted you away from that perilous situation more than anything. Only the premise of "neutralizing the assassin completely" would compel you to leave my side, would it not? I hope you can forgive my small deception.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Now, let me correct the record. The man before you is not a hound of the Underground. On the contrary, he was once an intelligence officer of DisCity, a distinguished agent of the 9th Agency, and a formidable soldier both despised and feared by the Underground—a legendary operative codenamed "Rust."

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Now, the reliable Agent Rust will escort you out of Fraser City to a place of greater safety. This will finally allow me to set my mind at ease.
Hypatia shows no hint of joy. Instead, she looks utterly dejected, her expression heavy with defeat.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Are you... still sending me away? Because I am a burden?

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: I wish for you to be removed from immediate danger.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But everyone is in danger now. No one can truly escape it. You are in peril, Ms. Margaret, as is everyone in Fraser and the Farland Alliance. I do not wish to flee from danger; I want to contribute, to help.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Do you believe... I am not qualified?

After a brief silence, the little bird gently alights on the young woman's shoulder and nuzzles her cheek. The voice that emerges from it is warm and smiling, as if Margaret's fond expression is somehow visible through her words.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: You are even stronger than I imagined, Hypatia. But do not misunderstand; I have never doubted your courage.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: I want you away from Fraser's dangers because I need you to address the source of the threat, and it is not here.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...But you said the <color=#fb9259>Unity Gala</color> would be the decisive battleground.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Indeed, because it will gather those who truly hold the power to decide.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: What determines outcomes is not the split-second choice made when weapons are drawn, but the long, subtle influences and preparations that precede any confrontation.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: We require a new mediator, someone who can journey personally into the WhiteSands... into the heart of the calamities.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Go among the people. Understand their hardships, honor their wishes, and bridge their misunderstandings. Only then can we dismantle Fraser's control over them and guide them back to the right side of history.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: I wish I could be that crucial bridge myself. But I was raised in DisCity, and I cannot overcome the historical animosity attached to my identity. They would never open their hearts to me. That is why this vital mission can only be entrusted to you.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Unite the Alliance... me...?
Hypatia had envisioned countless battles—repelling enemies, protecting friends, safeguarding hope. She had even imagined sacrificing her life in combat, refusing to ever stand aside.
But she had never imagined this would be the answer.

steps.speaker: Phantom's Voice
steps.content: Fool... you think you can outrun your guilt? Escape your duty? You promised you would save us...

steps.speaker: Victim's Voices
steps.content: You stood by, watching us die with open eyes... because you are even more hypocritical than your kin! Ptui!

steps.speaker: Hella?
steps.content: Where were you when the Furor refugees marched into the Black Ring? Where were you when I was trapped in there? You've got no guts, no spine; you can't get anything done! A coward like you doesn't deserve to be my friend!

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But I...
The Aurum Secretum bird opens its beak to continue, and is abruptly cut off as another voice seizes the conversation.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Still so good at issuing directives, Ambassador Margaret. Was commanding your own subordinates not enough? Now you're weaving schemes to enlist non-DisCitizens as well?

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: My, my... Hypatia is my treasured friend. It is out of concern for her that I requested your assistance. If you persist in driving a wedge between us, I may truly begin to take offense.
The man gives a faint, dismissive roll of his eyes.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh, sorry for commenting on your friendship with Miss Campbell. But please, refrain from attempting to draft me into your designs as well, won't you?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: How long has it been since you last communicated with your other "friend," Silver Spider? Were you unaware I've long since parted ways with the 9th Agency?

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Thank you for your concern. Our rapport remains as intimate as ever; we are old classmates, after all. Unlike some, who refuse missions from old friends, stubborn as a runaway boy... ah, forgive me, I meant "persistent."

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Nevertheless, through careful observation, I believe I understand you better now. For instance, given your temperament, you wouldn't stand idly by while a kind-hearted girl finds herself in grave peril, would you?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh. There are far too many "kind people" in distress around here. My waiting list is booked solid through next year.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Could you adjust her priority? You know that Hypatia is a Luminaris Society expert and a direct witness to BR-005.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: All I know is that she is a child. And I fundamentally disagree with both you and the Luminaris Society on this point.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Children like her should be kept far from conflicts from the start, given proper protection. Not dragged onto the "battlefield" to fulfill some abstract notion of "value."
His tone sharpens into ice, met only by the unwavering tenderness in Margaret's voice.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: You underestimate her, sir. Allow me to share something you may not know.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: During the Ash Campaign, while on the run for mere weeks, she independently analyzed and decoded the Aurum Secretum signature data from BR-005, transmitted it to the FAC Broken Frontline in DisCity, and ultimately facilitated the precise targeting and destruction of the Apostles, bringing the war to an early conclusion.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: All of this was accomplished by the "child" before you. Even outside the Luminaris Society, she remains a peerless scholarly talent, rivaling the frontline researchers of the Ring Research Institute.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Now, will you still maintain that condescending view, looking down on Hypatia as a mere "child"? On the path you yourself are desperately seeking, she may have already run ahead, closer than you to the "answer" you desire.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Do you not wish to see for yourself?
He doesn't answer. Instead, he turns toward Hypatia, his gaze resting on her for a long, silent moment.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You're right. My apologies, Researcher Campbell. You deserve far more respect than I have shown you.
Margaret's tone softens as well, mirroring the shift toward calm.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: She is a precious asset to both Fraser and DisCity. Yet, as you've just witnessed, here her talents are squandered, and her life is not valued. That, I believe, is the true tragedy.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: I believe we both wish to see... what she could truly achieve if allowed to flourish.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Very well. I'll go. But let one thing be clear.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I promise to ensure Miss Campbell's safety. However, my methods and judgments will not be swayed by you. As you noted, I have my own path to walk. It does not align with yours.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I suggest you factor that into your calculations, Madam "Peace Dove."
Amusement colors her tone, bright and unmistakable.

steps.speaker: Bird Communicator
steps.content: Thank you for the reminder. I shall keep it in mind.
[Scene Transition: Dove's portrait]

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hypatia, I know the shadows of BR-005 still linger within you. Asking you to step forward and face them once more... is perhaps a cruel request.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: But now... I need you more than ever.
The Aurum Secretum bird lands on Hypatia's shoulder and gently nuzzles against her cheek.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: The Black Ring has intensified the calamities. War has stripped away what little Aurum Secretum and Hypercubes remained. The farlands stand on the brink of a survival crisis. And yet, even now, Fraser continues to manipulate and exploit their desperation.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: They know that those who have lost everything are the most susceptible, that people cornered by despair are the easiest to control... Even a false hope becomes a precious treasure when it's all you have left.
Visions of Furor invade her mind, and the memory strikes Hypatia's heart with a physical ache.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Use your brilliance and your sincerity to cut through the fog for them. Bring them genuine hope. Do not allow such tragedies to repeat, for their sake, and for ours.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...I understand. If this concerns the future of the Alliance, and the survival of all...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I will give it my all.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Good. I'll spare you any more lengthy exhortations. I wish you both a safe journey. I'll be watching through our little friend here and will support you in any way I can.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hypa, Rust, we will meet again soon. And when we do, we shall celebrate peace together.
The farewell given, the display in the air winks out.
The farlands... journey to the farlands, clear up misunderstandings, and become a bridge for peace.

Hypatia turns the words over in her mind. She feels their weight, a cause to which she would gladly dedicate herself. But can these ideals truly be realized? This man standing before her... will he help her make them a reality?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Then, let's tend to your wounds promptly, and we set out afterward. Your mission will not be simple. We must make thorough preparations.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Yes. Oh wait.
Hypatia gathers herself. With deliberate grace, she takes a step back and performs a deep, formal curtsy.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Thank you for your generosity. I place myself in your care for the journey to the farlands.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Think nothing of it. We will be relying on each other.
With a smile, Rust extends his hand to Hypatia.
She hesitates for a moment, then finally takes it.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Thank you.
